# Draftava 1.2.4
- Fixed Unicode corruption when cutting or copying text and pasting it back into Draftava. - Improved editor drag-and-drop spacing so moved text no longer leaves or creates unwanted blank lines. - Kept the existing selection actions visible after moving text or dropping an Idea into the editor. - Added full-size image preview from Idea popups, with Escape returning to the normal popup. - Added Copy Image to the context menu for rendered images in the editor.
